intent.raw: Refine an API that agents can use to consult and get data for answering user questions through an agent.
intent.objective: Produce an MVP-ready, non-executed design and implementation plan for a protected read-only consultation API that returns source-linked Augmentor ontology evidence to an answering agent.
intent.operator_sentence: Refine an API that agents can consult to answer user questions.

route_menu.context_hint: The request could make the API a retrieval boundary, an answering service, or a knowledge-write service. Only the first preserves the current owner and authority boundaries.

items.label: Evidence API plus agent adapter
items.description: A protected read-only API returns bounded source-linked evidence; a separate answering agent composes the response. Selected because it preserves source, memory, and authority ownership.

items.label: API runs the answering agent
items.description: One endpoint retrieves evidence and generates prose. Deferred because retrieval, model behavior, identity, policy, and answer receipts would be coupled before their owners are selected.

items.label: Read and write knowledge API
items.description: Agents retrieve and update memory or ontology records. Rejected for this run because it would cross trusted-write and authority boundaries.

technique_overlays.trigger: The API needs a complete definition-to-critique-to-design-to-plan chain with explicit handoffs and stage evidence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes prior evidence and emits an owner-native artifact or blocked reason while preserving the package claim ceiling.

technique_overlays.trigger: Retrieval API, answering service, and knowledge-write service imply different owners and risk profiles.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design justifies the selected evidence-API-plus-agent-adapter route and records why the other routes remain deferred or rejected.

technique_overlays.trigger: Useful agent answers require broad retrieval, while trustworthy answers require narrow source, freshness, access, and authority limits.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Helpfulness and authority-preservation roles converge only when the API remains useful while unsupported, stale, conflicting, or unauthorized claims fail closed.

technique_overlays.trigger: The hidden structure spans ontology records, source handles, query planning, access policy, evidence reduction, agent context, and answer behavior.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The context and design artifacts expose components, owners, state, handoffs, data flow, and forbidden collapses as consumable artifacts or handles.

technique_overlays.trigger: A request/response abstraction can be challenged cheaply with representative question outcomes before implementation planning.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: A scenario artifact covers supported, ambiguous, unsupported, conflicting, stale, unauthorized, and oversized requests with expected evidence and answer behavior.

technique_overlays.trigger: The ontology and its source map are private, while future agent consumers require a neutral bounded projection and explicit access policy.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Private records, runtime projections, transient agent context, usage evidence, trusted memory, and canonical knowledge remain in named owner-controlled namespaces.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The authored API design needs one independent challenge across usefulness, privacy, evidence, and authority boundaries before repair and planning.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One read-only Interrogation helper can challenge the design without creating a governed multi-agent research pipeline or overlapping writes. The parent retains route, stage, gate, research, and final synthesis ownership.
context: The ontology is private, source-bound, candidate-local, and non-authoritative.
The user wants agents to consult data for answers, which creates a retrieval-versus-answering boundary.
The future consumer and runtime owner remain in workspace-resonant, which this run cannot mutate.
The current protected HTML deployment is presentation evidence, not an API or runtime contract.

roles.purpose: Independently review the proposed request, response, access, provenance, freshness, budget, abstention, and API-to-answering-agent contracts.
roles.owns: One read-only design-review receipt; no API design authority, source mutation, security approval, product change, or final synthesis.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm the standard Refine route and one read-only API-boundary reviewer at the design-review stage?

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Private source bytes are copied into an unrelated owner -> block
No component-owner map and no blocked reason -> block

steps.name: Invoke Define consultation API
convergence_criteria: An agent can obtain enough evidence to answer common supported questions.
The API cannot manufacture authority, mutate sources, or hide insufficient evidence.
The API/agent/owner boundaries and non-goals are explicit.
stop_conditions: Retrieval, answer generation, trusted memory, and authority are collapsed into one owner -> block

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: Every critical term has one owner and a falsifiable boundary.
Unresolved projection, identity, security, and freshness decisions are recorded as residue.
stop_conditions: A blocking owner or data-boundary ambiguity has no decision route -> block

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: External research starts without a named gap and explicit operator confirmation -> block

steps.name: Distill smallest coherent consultation contract
stop_conditions: The selected MVP cannot recompose into the answering-agent flow -> block

steps.name: Invoke Design API and agent boundary
convergence_criteria: The API supports useful bounded retrieval for the answering agent.
All returned claims carry source, status, freshness, confidence, and claim-ceiling context.
Writes, promotion, authority, and execution remain outside the API.
stop_conditions: The design exposes arbitrary filesystem or graph execution -> block
Access and error contracts are absent -> block

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: The design answers ordinary questions without masking missing or conflicting evidence.
Authorization, privacy, budgets, freshness, and owner boundaries have testable failure behavior.
stop_conditions: A critical security, authority, or answer-grounding failure lacks a repair route -> block

steps.name: Distill Repair with question toy scenarios
stop_conditions: Any unsupported, conflicting, stale, unauthorized, or oversized scenario yields an unqualified answer -> block

steps.name: Invoke non-executed implementation plan
stop_conditions: Plan performs product or deployment mutation -> block
Plan omits exact future tests, write scopes, or rollback boundaries -> block

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Final synthesis is not grounded in all stage artifacts -> block
Implementation, integration, release, or production is claimed -> block

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json must validate with status pass before any runtime-backed stage or subagent starts.
The operator explicitly confirms the displayed ten-stage route and one read-only API-boundary reviewer for this exact dispatch.
The approved API-boundary reviewer is spawned once at design review, joined, closed, and returns receipt:api-boundary-review before Distill Repair begins.
Every stage records a native stage receipt with its capability handle, status, artifacts or blocked reason, validation, and observer state.
External research may run only after a named gap and a separate bounded-research confirmation.
The consultation API is read-only and cannot mutate sources, trusted memory, ontology records, routing state, approvals, runs, or protected actions.
API output and agent answers remain source-linked interpretations; they grant no authority, trusted-memory admission, ontology admission, or effect permission.
The design specifies operations, selectors, budgets, response records, provenance, freshness, conflicts, access, errors, agent instructions, and abstention behavior.
This run produces design and plan artifacts only; API code, product integration, deployment, and release require a separately admitted execution route.
RESULT.md is grounded in the seed, dispatch, joined context receipts, all stage artifacts, scenario evidence, research decision, and open residue.

boundaries.contract: No runtime-backed stage or subagent starts until the operator confirms this exact strategy.
The helper receives only the seed and design artifacts, remains read-only, and returns one structured boundary-review receipt before close.
Private ontology material may inform the design locally but cannot become an unprotected runtime projection or public API payload.
The API returns bounded evidence records and answer guidance; the agent composes or abstains without converting API output into authority or trusted memory.
Refine may plan API and product changes but cannot perform or report them as implemented.
External evidence requires a named gap, operator confirmation, source attribution, and protected-context handling; it cannot override local owner evidence.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Before confirmation, only Refine-owned proposal artifacts may be written; after confirmation, stage artifacts remain inside declared run paths.
Read-only evidence source during this Refine run.
No writes during this Refine run.
Ephemeral bounded response only; no source, memory, ontology, routing, or run-state mutation.

promotion_splits.rule: The agent may use source-linked evidence within its claim ceiling; no trusted or canonical admission follows.

promotion_splits.source: agent answer or API usage receipt
promotion_splits.rule: Any durable admission requires the named memory or ontology owner review through a separate intake route.

promotion_guardrails: The consultation API remains read-only and non-authoritative.
An evidence bundle is not a source record, authority decision, approval, or effect permission.
An answering agent response is not automatically trusted memory or canonical knowledge.
A protected private design does not imply a safe public projection.
Refine output is design and planning evidence, not implementation, integration, deployment, release, or production evidence.
